_description: Parameters of the active-learning benchmark reported in the paper. Loaded by src/active_learning_benchmark_700dpi.py and overriding its CONFIG defaults. Paths are set in the script.

_representations.Mordred: 1,826 Mordred descriptors (ignore_3D=False, no conformers -> 3-D descriptors missing -> removed by variance filter)
_representations.PF: Chem.rdmolops.PatternFingerprint, 2048 bits (SMARTS substructure patterns; not path-based)
_representations.GCN: learned; trained end-to-end, MC-Dropout uncertainty, same EI / seeds / budget; no GPR

_notes.random_seeds: AL seeds are 0..n_random_seeds-1, i.e. {0,1,2,3,4}; the same initial sets are used for every representation, the GCN and the random baseline.
_notes.high_efficiency_pool: PCE > 12 % = 370 of 1,481 molecules (25.0 %). Not a top-10 % pool (the 90th percentile is 14.3 %).
_notes.correlation_filter: applied only when <= 300 features remain after the variance filter (RDKit, MACCS).
_notes.pca: fitted on the whole pool (no labels); 95 % variance target capped at 50 components -> APF 69.1 %, Avalon 81.8 %, PF 87.9 % retained.
_notes.gcn_architecture: 2 GCNConv(64) + ReLU, global mean pool, Linear 64->32 (ReLU) -> 1, dropout 0.2; 19 node features (16-element one-hot, degree/10, formal charge/4, aromatic); no edge features.
